candidate.definition_en: To arrange people or things in a row; to organize or prepare.
candidate.explanation_ar: يصطف أو يوقف ناس في طابور، وممكن تيجي بمعنى يجهز أو يرتب لحاجة.

senses.definition_en: To form a row or place people or things into a row or queue.
senses.definition_ar: يصطف أو يرتب أشخاصاً أو أشياء في صف واحد
examples: Spectators began to line-up along the street hours before the parade started.
The director asked the actors to line-up on stage for the final curtain call.

senses.definition_en: To organize, secure, or schedule someone or something for an event.
senses.definition_ar: يجهز أو يرتب أو يوفر أشخاصاً أو خدمات لحدث معين
examples: The committee managed to line-up several prominent keynote speakers for the summit.
Spectators began to line-up along the street hours before the parade started.
The director asked the actors to line-up on stage for the final curtain call.
The committee managed to line-up several prominent keynote speakers for the summit.
